company.name: ROME Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: ROME Therapeutics is developing novel therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases by harnessing the power of the repeatome.
company.description: ROME Therapeutics is developing novel therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases by harnessing the power of the repeatome – vast stretches of uncharted genetic material that have long been dismissed as “junk DNA.” With several drug targets identified and multiple discovery programs underway, ROME is moving rapidly to leverage this new frontier in biology. To lead this exploration, ROME has assembled a team of world-class leaders across fields including oncology, immunology, virology and machine learning.

aiResearchSummary.text: ROME Therapeutics is focused on developing therapies for cancer and autoimmune diseases by targeting LINE1 and HERV-K reverse transcriptase. Their research includes compounds like cyclopentene-oxymethylene phosphonamidates, halo-dehydro-3'-deoxyuracil phosphoramidates, and 4'-halomethyl-cytidine phosphoramidates. These compounds are designed to inhibit reverse transcriptase activity, which is crucial in treating these disorders. The company also explores the use of compounds such as stampidine, islatravir, and censavudine for similar therapeutic purposes.
